output.reason: [ev-63314a5fae82] says the new behaviour is the 3.0 default, and you keep the v2 behaviour by setting `ignoreDifferencesOnResourceUpdates` to false in `resource.compareoptions` in argocd-cm. So the exposed environments are the ones that do NOT set that key, including ones with no `resource.compareoptions` at all. The proposed condition (`resource.compareoptions` is set) gets this backwards: it misses installs that never set `resource.compareoptions`, which are exposed, and it flags installs that already pinned the key, which are protected. The change only matters if system-level `ignoreDifferences` customizations already exist. The evidence doesn't name the argocd-cm keys that hold them, so that part has to stay undecidable.

correction.statement: Exposed: Argo CD installations whose argocd-cm `resource.compareoptions` does not set `ignoreDifferencesOnResourceUpdates` (including when `resource.compareoptions` is absent) and that have system-level `ignoreDifferences` customizations. Under the 3.0 default, changes to those ignored fields stop generating application diffs. Protected (overlap): installations that set `ignoreDifferencesOnResourceUpdates` explicitly in `resource.compareoptions`.

of.needed: whether system-level ignoreDifferences customizations are configured (the evidence does not name the argocd-cm keys that carry them)
